text: The document (v2.3, reviewed 2026-08-05) specifies the RAG Knowledge Platform's implemented architecture: three long-running services plus one MCP layer, all configured from a single `config.yml`. A Nuxt 3 web UI (dev 6789/prod 3000) proxies server-to-server so browsers never hit FastAPI directly, and owns the on-disk KB store (`.tree-fs.json`, `.knowledge-base.yml`). The FastAPI backend (dev 8765/prod 8001) handles parse scheduling, MinerU OCR subprocess lifecycle, the ChromaDB + BGE-M3 vector index, Neo4j graph, experience store, SOUL persona training, and meditation scheduling. kb-mcp (FastMCP) exposes 94 tools over stdio, isolating all HTTP in `kb_client/client.py`; parse, graph, reindex, and training tools are non-blocking, returning a `task_id`. MinerU runs hidden on an ephemeral port (never hardcoded). It also covers the five-layer storage model, QDCVR retrieval, experience lifecycle, and mandatory change conventions.
